api_key.description: the api key from subdl account

season_number.description: Specific season number for TV shows.

episode_number.description: Specific episode number for TV shows.

type.description: Type of the content, either movie or tv.

year.description: Release year of the movie or TV show.

languages.description: Comma-separated language codes for subtitle languages. list of supported languages

subs_per_page.description: limit of subtitles will see in the results default is 10, (max can be 30)

comment.description: send comment=1 to get author comment on subtitle

releases.description: send releases=1 to get releases list on subtitle

hi.description: send hi=1 to get is Hearing Impaired on subtitle

full_season.description: send full_season=1 to get all full season subtitles
